title: Quantum black hole ringdown
summary: The ringdown of a black hole following a merger is a potential candidate for revealing the signatures of quantum gravity in the emerging gravitational waves. In quantum theory, black holes are expected to have a discrete area and energy spectrum, which conflicts with the classical notion of an horizon that absorbs all infalling perturbations. We propose that the quantum black hole dissipates the energy it cannot absorb by emitting ``soft'' gravitons that carry away the energy difference between the energy of the infalling perturbation and the quantum transition energy.
